about: Every colour role of the stylesheet of the floor this plugin serves, one entry each, named the way the stylesheet adapter names them: where its value comes from, and the pairs of text and ground it is measured in. A role's value comes from one of three sources. formula: the guide writes it from a choice of the owner through the formula named. follows: it takes the value of another role, once the owner's word for its question says so; until then the floor's value stays. floor: kept from the floor, by the owner's word with a name and a day. A role whose question has no word yet waits on the owner. Each role is text on the grounds in `on`, measured at the conformance level's threshold for text, and a part that is not text against the grounds in `against`, measured at the threshold for parts that are not text. A role measured in no pair says why in `unmeasured`.

formulas.primary-on-background: the source colour itself when it reaches the threshold on the background of each mode, else the nearest lightness of its hue that does
formulas.text-on-primary: the floor's near-white or near-black, whichever has the higher contrast on the primary
formulas.ring-is-primary: the primary of the same mode

color-roles-sidebar.question: Do the sidebar's primary, its text and its focus ring follow the primary colour, or are they kept from the floor?
color-roles-sidebar.why: The sidebar marks the page a person is on with its primary: kept from the floor, it is the floor's colour and not the owner's in at least one mode.

color-roles-neutral.question: Are the neutral roles (background, text, card, popover, secondary, muted, accent, border, input and the sidebar's own) kept from the floor?
color-roles-neutral.later: the neutral family (pure grey, or grey leaning to the source colour), a choice a later version of this plugin brings

color-roles-status.question: Is the destructive role kept from the floor?
color-roles-status.later: the status tones the product uses, a choice a later version of this plugin brings

color-roles-chart.question: Are the five chart roles kept from the floor?
color-roles-chart.why: No formula writes chart colours in this version: kept from the floor, or set by a person outside the guide.

roles.unmeasured: a border sets parts apart; it is not what a person reads, and the floor's own is lighter than 3:1 by design
the edge of a field, drawn by the component with its own ground: the review measures it on the screen
a chart's colours are read beside each other on its plot, which the table does not know
